channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 26 November
item.description: The wallet was updated to use shared AI rules. Multinode tests in the cognitive system were changed to run on the loopback address. Repositories: GeniusWallet, GeniusCognitiveSystem, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 25 November
item.description: Security threat verification was added to the network and session records were fixed, with milestone files cleaned up. The cognitive system pinned all build pipelines to self‑hosted runners and updated its CI validation. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusCognitiveSystem, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 24 November
item.description: Network and SuperGenius fixes addressed cold‑storage tags and dispatch upgrades, while the cognitive system added an architecture‑review skill and synced documentation. Generated SDK models were refreshed. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, thirdparty.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 23 November
item.description: Network and SuperGenius fixed iOS cold‑storage tag issues and other build stubs, and the cognitive system incorporated a test fix for MSVC/clang. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-client-scaffold.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 22 November
item.description: The wallet fixed a frozen startup feed and rename behavior, added tests for rename actions, and updated its configuration. SuperGenius repaired record cleanup, upgraded phases, and tested funding reservation leaks. Repositories: GeniusWallet, SuperGenius.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 21 November
item.description: SuperGenius added recovery of nonce certificates, improved handling of payouts and pruned holds, and performed extensive testing and refactoring. GeniusNetwork updated pointers, performed test work, and recorded checkpoint rulings. Repositories: SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork.
